mapper.update: UPDATE pf.task SET active_started_at=coalesce(active_started_at,clock_timestamp()), execution_deadline_at=coalesce(active_started_at,clock_timestamp())+((120000-active_millis)*interval '1 millisecond') WHERE id=#{task} AND quota_mode='USER_DAILY' AND active_millis<120000

UPDATE pf.task SET active_millis=active_millis+greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM(clock_timestamp()-active_started_at))*1000)::bigint, active_started_at=NULL WHERE id=#{task} AND active_started_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pf.task WHERE conversation_id=#{conversation} AND status='WAITING_INPUT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.acceptance_run(id,stage) VALUES(#{run},'R4.1') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.acceptance_run SET physical_requests=physical_requests+1 WHERE id=#{run} AND physical_requests<20
mapper.select: SELECT greatest(0,t.reserved_tokens-coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN r.state='SETTLED' THEN m.input_tokens+m.output_tokens WHEN r.state IN ('RESERVED','RECONCILING') THEN r.tokens ELSE 0 END),0)) AS tokens, greatest(0,t.reserved_micros-coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN r.state='SETTLED' THEN m.cost_micros WHEN r.state IN ('RESERVED','RECONCILING') THEN r.amount_micros ELSE 0 END),0)) AS cost FROM pf.task t LEFT JOIN pf.model_call m ON m.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN pf.budget_reservation r ON r.call_id=m.id WHERE t.id=#{task} GROUP BY t.id
